intro: About 140 kcal for 1 lepat pisang. Most of the calories come from the banana, flour and sugar in the batter.
diet: Yes, lepat pisang is one of the lighter kuih because it's steamed, not fried. Part of the sweetness comes from the banana itself. One piece as a tea-time snack is totally okay. But it's almost all carbs, so it's better to pair it with some protein.
tips: Eat just 1 piece, keep the rest for tomorrow.
If making your own, use really ripe bananas and cut down the sugar.
Pair with a glass of milk or a small cup of nuts to stay full longer.

swap.name: 1 fresh banana
swap.why: Same sweet taste, without the flour and added sugar.

faq.q: Which banana is best for lepat pisang?
faq.a: Very ripe pisang raja or pisang nangka. The riper, the sweeter and more fragrant.

faq.q: Why is my lepat pisang hard?
faq.a: Usually too much flour or steamed too long. The batter should be soft and a bit sticky.

faq.q: Can lepat pisang be kept in the fridge?
faq.a: Yes, it lasts 2-3 days. Steam again for 5 minutes to soften it.
